task.name: Sparse pancyclic graphs on 40 vertices
task.description: construct() -> {'edges': undirected edge pairs on vertices 0..39, 'cycles': one vertex-list cycle of every length 3..40 in that order}. Edges are simple and distinct; cycle vertices are distinct and every required edge must exist. Minimize edge count minus 40. This is an independently implemented n=40 construction search with explicit cycle certificates. The seed is an elementary fan graph, not a copied minimal construction.
